Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing ‘*’ and then ‘0’ on your touch- tone phone.
A warm welcome to all of you to the Q1 FY '27 Earnings Call of L&T.

willDo: I will first walk you through the important highlights for Q1 FY '27 in the next 20 to 25 minutes or so, post which we will be taking the Q&A.
Given the strength of our opportunity pipeline and the underlying market dynamics, we remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band for the current year.
For now, we remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.
weaknesses: Our PPM business EBITDA margin for Q1 FY '27 was at 7% and declined by 20 basis points compared to the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
The segment revenue for Q1 FY '27 stood at Rs. 56 billion registering a decline of 11% Y-on-Y while margins remained largely stable compared to the corresponding period of the previous year.
Global growth is expected to remain moderate in the near term, reflecting softer growth in the U.S., weak domestic demand in China, and persistent inflationary pressures in parts of Europe.

Larsen & Toubro Limited May 05, 2026 Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good evening and welcome to Larsen & Toubro Limited Q4 FY '26 Earnings Conference Call.
A very warm welcome to all of you to the Q4 FY '26 Earnings Call of Larsen & Toubro.
The earnings presentation was uploaded on the stock exchange and on our website around 6:20 PM.

willDo: I will first walk you through the important highlights for Q4 FY '26 and the full year FY '26, followed by an overview of our strategic plan for the next 5 years, that is Lakshya 31, after which we will take questions.
On the revenue front, growth for FY26 stood at 12% compared to our guidance of 15%.
On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well.
weaknesses: The Projects and Manufacturing portfolio margin declined by 50 basis points YoY to 9.4% and is largely reflective of the change in the revenue mix.
Moving on to prospects pipeline, our prospects pipeline for FY27 is Rs 17.8 trillion as compared to Rs 19.02 trillion at the same time last year, reflecting a decline of 6%.
The EBITDA margin in the Projects and Manufacturing business for Q4 FY '26 is at 9.4% and has declined by 50 basis points from 9.9% in Q4 FY '25.
threats: Growth conditions, however, remain subject to external headwinds, including geopolitical developments, global energy supply dynamics, softer external demand, and periods of financial market volatility.

Nonetheless, the domestic economy remains supported by sound macroeconomic fundamentals, with steady demand providing resilience, even as growth becomes sensitive to external and climate-related influences.
